Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from activities on human single-protein target CHEMBL1946. Join target_dictionary to assays to activities to molecule_dictionary to compound_structures. Filter to standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not deduplicate. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000.
